plugins.name: aaron-intelligence
plugins.description: Aaron's personal Claude Code enhancements — a growing bundle of hooks, skills, and commands tuned to how he works. (1) A PreToolUse Bash guard that soft-blocks using the shell (cat/head/tail, sed -i, echo>file) as a stand-in for the Read/Edit/Write tools; precision-first, so pipelines, tail -f, awk/grep, and program-output redirects are left alone. Off via AARON_INTELLIGENCE_GUARD=off. (2) repo-standards — applies one canonical default-branch ruleset and a sole-CODEOWNER PR via the gh CLI, from a versioned standard.json. (3) private-repo-standards — the fallback for private repos on GitHub Free, where rulesets, branch protection, and CODEOWNERS are all Pro-gated.
